name: omp-jev-router
description: Keeps the primary model fixed while routing orchestration and three worker tiers with Jev; includes checkpoint reviews and independent verification.

jevModel.description: TypeSafe model id; empty uses the SDK default (jev-latest).

orchestrationRoutingEnabled.description: Decide whether to activate native orchestration at request start and after a committed todo plan change; never changes the primary model.

orchestrationMinConfidence.description: Minimum confidence for orchestration; below the gate keep DEFAULT and the current primary model.

orchestrationMinMargin.description: Minimum top1 - top2 margin for orchestration; below the gate keep DEFAULT.

taskRoutingEnabled.description: Pick task_easy, task_hard or task_challenge for generic task spawns.

taskMinConfidence.description: Minimum tier confidence; uncertainty selects task_challenge.

taskMinMargin.description: Minimum tier probability margin; uncertainty selects task_challenge.

easyTaskRole.description: Model role for mechanical, low-risk TASK_EASY work.

hardTaskRole.description: Model role for substantive TASK_HARD implementation.

challengeTaskRole.description: Model role for TASK_CHALLENGE reasoning and uncertain task decisions.

routingTimeoutMs.description: Hard per-decision budget; expiry falls back instead of retrying.

maxRoutingInputChars.description: Combined character budget for task text, visible conversation and committed plan sent to Jev (excluding JSON framing and fixed classifier instructions).

telemetryEnabled.description: Aggregate local route counts and worker cost. No prompt text is stored.

debugLogging.description: Emit one metrics-only line per routing decision to the OMP log.

scripts.build: bun run gen:agents && bun run check && bun run lint && bun test
scripts.format: oxfmt src scripts test bin package.json tsconfig.json
